title: Binary vector enumeration work
statement: Let $V_\ell$ be the list of binary vectors of length $\ell$, defined by $V_0=[0]$ and, for each $\ell$, by concatenating the vectors obtained by prefixing $0$ to each element of $V_\ell$ with those obtained by prefixing $1$. Define the enumeration work by $W_0=1$ and $W_{\ell+1}=W_\ell+3|V_\ell|+1$, where $|V_\ell|$ is the list length.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $\ell$ indexing the vector length
